newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Basis mostly weak, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Basis mostly weak, trade slow.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat were mostly weak Monday at interior and Gulf locations, and merchandisers said movement had slowed from last week's active pace.
"We saw some decent farmer selling on Friday, but it's pretty slow right now," a merchandiser in central Kansas said.
Meanwhile, dealers said conditions were becoming dry in many areas of the central and southern U.S. Plains.
"We haven't received a drop in some time," another Kansas dealer said. "Down in southwest Kansas they could use a little drink of water right now but it's nothing dire."
Thunderstorms were expected to pass through parts of eastern Kansas and Oklahoma Monday, dealers said.
A two-day precipitation forecast map published Monday by meteorology firm Weather Express Inc showed that eastern Oklahoma and Kansas could pick up between 0.2 and 2.0 inches of rain from the storms.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: K=KCBT May wheat futures. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
